latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: moneybigA v1.0.0 — multi-framework institutional-grade stock analysis

- Provides technical, fundamental, and quantitative analysis (A/H/US stocks), including chip distribution, main force control, Wyckoff, SMC Order Block, Elliott Wave, MACD, and Alpha 101 factor scoring.
- Outputs interactive HTML analysis dashboard with comprehensive scoring (0–100), multi-level buy/sell signals, risk conditions, stop loss and target price reference.
- Covers real-time data collection via WebSearch (no credentials required), with clear scope on supported and unsupported requests.
- Does not execute real trades, write to local files, or save user data; analysis is for research and education only.
- Installable and instantly usable in Claude Code — no environment variables or API tokens needed.
